children: Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications said August core consumer price index rose 1.7% from a year earlier, below the median estimate of 1.8%. According to Sina Finance, the core CPI excludes volatile fresh food prices. Overall CPI rose 1.9% year on year, versus an estimate of 2%, while CPI excluding energy and fresh food also rose 1.9%, versus an estimate of 2%.

title: Japan's August Core CPI Rises 1.7%, Below 1.8% Estimate
